# Grafana documentation

> Grafana Labs builds open and composable observability software, including Grafana, Grafana Cloud, Loki, Mimir, Tempo, Pyroscope, Alloy, Beyla, Faro, and k6.

This file is a curated documentation index for AI agents and other automated consumers.

Use this file for discovery. The links below point directly to machine-readable Markdown pages on `https://grafana.com`.

For a larger exhaustive index, use [llms-full.txt](/llms-full.txt).

All Grafana documentation pages support a machine-readable Markdown form:
- Append `.md` to the canonical docs URL.
- Or request the canonical docs URL with `Accept: text/markdown`.

## Our core stack

Unlock the full potential of your data with our platform, where you can query and visualize metrics, logs, and traces to gain a deeper understanding of your system's performance and behavior.


### Grafana

Query, visualize, and understand your data.

- [Grafana Cloud](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/learn-and-build/visualizations.md)
- [Grafana OSS](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest.md)
- [Grafana Enterprise](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/introduction/grafana-enterprise.md)

### Metrics

Store and query raw, unsampled metrics for all your applications and infrastructure.

- [Grafana Cloud](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/send-data/metrics.md#ways-to-connect-your-data-to-grafana-cloud)
- [Grafana OSS](https://grafana.com/docs/mimir/latest.md)
- [Grafana Enterprise](https://grafana.com/docs/enterprise-metrics/latest.md)

### Logs

Store and query logs from all your applications and infrastructure.

- [Grafana Cloud](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/send-data/logs.md)
- [Grafana OSS](https://grafana.com/docs/loki/latest.md)
- [Grafana Enterprise](https://grafana.com/docs/enterprise-logs/latest.md)

### Traces

Visualize the lifecycle of a request as it passes through a set of applications.

- [Grafana Cloud](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/send-data/traces.md)
- [Grafana OSS](https://grafana.com/docs/tempo/latest.md)
- [Grafana Enterprise](https://grafana.com/docs/enterprise-traces/latest.md)

## Observability, AI, testing, and Incident Response Management (IRM)

Comprehensive documentation that covers the entire lifecycle, from testing and instrumentation to AI-powered observability and incident response management, aimed to help you minimize mean time to resolution.


### Observability

Docs that support your infrastructure and application observability needs.

- [OpenTelemetry](https://grafana.com/docs/opentelemetry.md)
- [Kubernetes (k8s) Monitoring](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/monitor-infrastructure/kubernetes-monitoring.md)
- [Cloud Provider Observability](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/monitor-infrastructure/monitor-cloud-provider.md)
- [Frontend Observability](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/monitor-applications/frontend-observability.md)
- [Application Observability](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/monitor-applications/application-observability.md)
- [Database Observability](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/monitor-infrastructure/database-observability.md)
- [Knowledge graph](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/knowledge-graph.md)
- [AI Observability](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/monitor-applications/ai-observability.md)
- [Profiles](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/monitor-applications/profiles.md)

### AI and Machine Learning

Built-in AI and machine learning features that help you get more out of your observability data.

- [Grafana Assistant](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/platform/grafana-assistant.md)
- [Machine learning](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/machine-learning/dynamic-alerting.md)
- [LLM plugin](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/machine-learning/llm.md)
- [Sift](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/machine-learning/sift.md)

### Alerting and Incident Response (IRM)

Enable your teams to detect, respond to, and learn from incidents.

- [Alerting](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/alerting-and-irm/alerting.md)
- [IRM](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/alerting-and-irm/irm.md)
- [Service Center](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/alerting-and-irm/service-center.md)
- [SLO](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/alerting-and-irm/slo.md)

### Performance and Testing

Our load testing tools make performance testing easy and productive for engineering teams.

- [Performance testing](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/testing/k6.md)
- [Synthetic Monitoring](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/testing/synthetic-monitoring.md)

## Learning Hub

New to Grafana Cloud and unsure where to begin? Start with recommended learning journeys, then follow focused learning paths or dive into self-paced courses. [Go to the Learning Hub](/docs/learning-hub/).


### Learning paths

Short, focused paths you can follow independently or as part of a recommended journey.

- [Get started with Grafana Cloud](https://grafana.com/docs/learning-hub/is-grafana-cloud-right-for-me.md)
- [Monitor a Linux server in Grafana Cloud](https://grafana.com/docs/learning-paths/linux-server-integration.md)
- [Connect to a Prometheus data source in Grafana Cloud](https://grafana.com/docs/learning-paths/prometheus.md)
- [Explore data using Metrics Drilldown](https://grafana.com/docs/learning-paths/drilldown-metrics.md)
- [Visualize metrics in a Grafana Cloud dashboard](https://grafana.com/docs/learning-paths/visualization-metrics.md)
- [Browse all learning paths](https://grafana.com/docs/learning-hub.md#learning-paths)

### Learning journeys

Deepen your technical knowledge with self-paced sections.

- [Intro to Grafana Cloud](https://grafana.com/docs/learning-hub/intro-to-grafana-cloud.md)
- [Intro to integrations](https://grafana.com/docs/learning-hub/intro-to-integrations.md)
- [Intro to send data](https://grafana.com/docs/learning-hub/intro-to-send-data.md)
- [Intro to data sources](https://grafana.com/docs/learning-hub/intro-to-data-sources.md)
- [Intro to Cloud Provider Observability](https://grafana.com/docs/learning-hub/intro-to-cp-olly.md)
- [Browse all journeys](https://grafana.com/docs/learning-hub.md#journeys)

### Docs decision support

Unsure which docs you need? Answer a few questions, and Grot will guide you to the appropriate docs.

- [Which Grafana is right for me?](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud.md?guide=whichgrafana#guidance-and-help)
- [Traces and Profiles](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/monitor-applications/profiles.md?guide=profiling#guidance-and-help)
- [Monitor infrastructure](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/monitor-infrastructure.md?guide=monitor-infrastructure#guidance-and-help)
- [Kubernetes Monitoring](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/monitor-infrastructure/kubernetes-monitoring.md?guide=kubernetes#guidance-and-help)

## Connect and visualize data

Discover the various methods for sending or connecting data to Grafana Cloud. Once your data is in place, you can visualize it to gain valuable insights that help you tackle real-world challenges.


### Instrument and send data

Set up your infrastructure and applications to transmit telemetry data to Grafana Cloud.

- [Grafana Alloy](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/send-data/alloy.md)
- [Grafana integrations](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/monitor-infrastructure/integrations.md)
- [Fleet Management](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/send-data/fleet-management.md)
- [AWS PrivateLink](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/send-data/private-connectivity/aws-privatelink.md)
- [Azure Private Link](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/send-data/private-connectivity/azure-privatelink.md)
- [Google Private Service Connect](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/send-data/private-connectivity/gcp-psc.md)
- [OTLP end point](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/send-data/otlp.md)
- [Grafana Beyla](https://grafana.com/docs/beyla/latest.md)

### Visualize data

Use visualizations to gain actionable insight into your telemetry data.

- [Create a dashboard](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/visualizations/dashboards/build-dashboards/create-dashboard.md)
- [Use a dashboard](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/visualizations/dashboards/use-dashboards.md)
- [Query and transform data](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/visualizations/panels-visualizations/query-transform-data.md)
- [Visualizations](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/visualizations/panels-visualizations/visualizations.md)

## Open source projects from Grafana Labs

At Grafana Labs, open source continues to be our driving force as we work to develop and evolve our core OSS tools and technologies.

- [Grafana](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest.md)
- [Mimir](https://grafana.com/docs/mimir/latest.md)
- [Tempo](https://grafana.com/docs/tempo/latest.md)
- [Loki](https://grafana.com/docs/loki/latest.md)
- [Pyroscope](https://grafana.com/docs/pyroscope/latest.md)
- [Alloy](https://grafana.com/docs/alloy/latest.md)
- [Beyla](https://grafana.com/docs/beyla/latest.md)
- [Faro](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/monitor-applications/frontend-observability.md)
- [Alerting](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/alerting.md)
- [k6](https://grafana.com/docs/k6/latest.md)
- [Prometheus](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/datasources/prometheus.md)
- [Writers’ Toolkit](https://grafana.com/docs/writers-toolkit.md)
- [OpenTelemetry](https://grafana.com/docs/opentelemetry.md)

## Grafana Cloud account management

Create an account, get started with Grafana Cloud, and manage your account.

- [Get started with Grafana Cloud](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/get-started.md)
- [Account management](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/account-management.md)

## Resources

Consult the following resources, as necessary.

- [Writers' Toolkit](https://grafana.com/docs/writers-toolkit.md)
- [Release life cycle for Grafana Labs](https://grafana.com/docs/release-life-cycle.md)

This guide shows you how to control costs without impacting existing telemetry.
- [Optimize egress costs with multi-tier sampling](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/observe-and-act/adaptive-telemetry/adaptive-traces/guides/multi-tier-sampling-trace-state.md): Learn how to combine collector-side probabilistic sampling with Adaptive Traces tail sampling using OpenTelemetry trace state, so you can reduce the egress and processing cost of your traces without distorting span metrics.
- [Introduction to Adaptive Traces](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/observe-and-act/adaptive-telemetry/adaptive-traces/introduction.md): Learn more about the fundamentals and available features that help you optimize your use of Adaptive Traces.
- [Manage Adaptive Traces as code](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/observe-and-act/adaptive-telemetry/adaptive-traces/manage-as-code.md): Learn how to manage your Adaptive Traces configuration at scale and integrate it into your existing infrastructure-as-code workflows using the Adaptive Traces HTTP API.
- [Adaptive Traces HTTP API](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/observe-and-act/adaptive-telemetry/adaptive-traces/manage-as-code/adaptive-traces-api.md): Use the Adaptive Traces HTTP API to manage your sampling policies and recommendations at scale and integrate them into your existing infrastructure-as-code workflows.
- [Monitor](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/observe-and-act/adaptive-telemetry/adaptive-traces/monitor.md): Compare your trace data before and after enabling Adaptive Traces.
- [Query dropped traces](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/observe-and-act/adaptive-telemetry/adaptive-traces/query-dropped-traces.md): Adaptive Traces keeps every dropped trace queryable by trace ID for 24 hours after ingest.
- [Reference](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/observe-and-act/adaptive-telemetry/adaptive-traces/reference.md): Reference-level documentation for various parts of Adaptive Traces.
- [Policy types](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/observe-and-act/adaptive-telemetry/adaptive-traces/reference/policy_types.md): Reference-level documentation for policy types.
- [Review and apply recommendations](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/observe-and-act/adaptive-telemetry/adaptive-traces/manage-recommendations.md): Describes how to manage provided Adaptive Traces recommendations.
- [Investigate anomalies](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/observe-and-act/adaptive-telemetry/adaptive-traces/manage-recommendations/investigate-anomalies.md): Describes how to review and investigate anomalies.
- [Use diversity sampling](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/observe-and-act/adaptive-telemetry/adaptive-traces/manage-recommendations/diversity-policy.md): Describes how diversity sampling keeps at least one trace per unique fingerprint so rare and low-traffic behavior stays visible.
- [Use volumetric sampling](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/observe-and-act/adaptive-telemetry/adaptive-traces/manage-recommendations/volumetric-policy.md): Learn how volumetric sampling targets a percentage of overall ingest and distributes that budget evenly across trace types so low-volume services aren't crowded out by noisy, high-volume ones.
- [Testing and synthetics](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/observe-and-act/testing.md)
- [Performance testing with Grafana Cloud k6](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/observe-and-act/testing/k6.md): Create performance test scripts using JavaScript, run your tests on servers all over the world, and visualize your test results in Grafana Cloud k6.
- [Analyze test results](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/observe-and-act/testing/k6/analyze-results.md): The following topics describe how you can analyze, manage, and export test results in Grafana Cloud k6.
- [Collect profiles with Grafana Pyroscope](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/observe-and-act/testing/k6/analyze-results/integrate-with-grafana-pyroscope.md): Integrate k6 with Grafana Pyroscope to automatically link test metadata with profiling labels, identify bottlenecks, and optimize your application performance
- [Compare tests](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/observe-and-act/testing/k6/analyze-results/test-comparison.md): To find regressions, you can compare data from multiple test runs. Grafana Cloud k6 provides three graphical ways to compare tests over time
- [Correlate results in Grafana](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/observe-and-act/testing/k6/analyze-results/correlate-results-in-grafana.md): Combine test results in different Grafana dashboards.
- [Correlate results with Grafana Cloud Traces](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/observe-and-act/testing/k6/analyze-results/integration-with-grafana-cloud-traces.md): Integrate k6 with Grafana Cloud Traces to get tracing telemetry data for your tests, and dive deeper into what happens inside your services while your load tests are running.
- [Export test results](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/observe-and-act/testing/k6/analyze-results/export-results.md): Export your k6 test results as a PDF report or CSV file.
- [Get Cloud Insights](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/observe-and-act/testing/k6/analyze-results/get-cloud-insights.md): Grafana Cloud k6 Cloud Insights are automated algorithms that help highlight and diagnose performance issues.
- [Cloud Insights reference](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/observe-and-act/testing/k6/analyze-results/get-cloud-insights/reference.md): Reference information for Grafana Cloud k6 Cloud Insights audits, categories, and groups, including details on how each audit impacts your performance tests and recommendations on how to fix them
- [Configure Cloud Insights](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/observe-and-act/testing/k6/analyze-results/get-cloud-insights/configure.md): Configure Grafana Cloud k6 Cloud Insights to enable or disable the audits you need for your performance tests
- [Inspect browser test results](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/observe-and-act/testing/k6/analyze-results/inspect-browser-test-results.md): View and analyze a Grafana Cloud k6 browser test run using the Browser Timeline and Browser Screenshot features
- [Inspect test results](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/observe-and-act/testing/k6/analyze-results/inspect-test-results.md): Grafana Cloud k6 provides views that visualize, analyze, and present trends for the test results. This topic describes the primary sections of the Test Result view.
- [Inspect checks](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/observe-and-act/testing/k6/analyze-results/inspect-test-results/inspect-checks.md): Inspect the checks from your test script to validate that your system is behaving as expected, and narrow down on any issues that happened during your test run.
- [Inspect logs](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/observe-and-act/testing/k6/analyze-results/inspect-test-results/inspect-logs.md): Inspect the logs from your test script to help you debug any test issues.
- [Inspect metrics](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/observe-and-act/testing/k6/analyze-results/inspect-test-results/inspect-metrics.md): Explore system and custom metrics from your test run, and add them to your Grafana dashboards to correlate results with other application metrics.
- [Inspect request data](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/observe-and-act/testing/k6/analyze-results/inspect-test-results/inspect-request-data.md): Inspect the HTTP, WebSocket, and gRPC request data from your test run to see how your system behaves during a test execution, and help you analyze and debug issues with any services or specific requests.
